content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text uses a single verse’s divided aspects—word wording and prophetic application—as its reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which is the kind of single-verse openness K-S2 addresses.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand: reading one treats the verse's wording/application duality as two senses that both stand and bars UNDERDETERMINED; reading two limits it to same-verse semantic ambiguity and would not reach this text.","why":"The judge gave UNDERDETERMINED on the basis that the virgin/young-woman wording and the prophetic application were answered separately, treating the single verse's two senses as open instead of letting both stand."}
